title: Minimum full thread in a blind tapped hole, when none is asked for
formula: max(floor((drill_depth - less_pitches * pitch) / round_down_mm) * round_down_mm, at_least_pitches * pitch), the larger taken only if strictly greater

source.practice: specify-core's default minimum full thread: the drill depth less three pitches for the tap's lead and the drill point, rounded down to 0.5 mm
